metadata.question: Was the nighttime brightness over Mayfield, Kentucky higher in November 2021 than on December 10-12, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use VIIRS nighttime lights data (VNP46A2 collection) for Mayfield, Kentucky. Need to compare: - November 2021 (entire month) - December 10-12, 2021 (3-day period) 2. Masking strategy: VIIRS has quality flags - I'll use the Mandatory_QA_Flags band to filter out poor quality pixels. 3. Logic: Calculate mean brightness for each period and compare. Need to handle cases where data is missing or all pixels are masked. Let me break this down: - Location: Mayfield, Kentucky (36.7417° N, 88.6364° W) - Data: VIIRS VNP46A2 for nighttime lights - Bands: DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL for brightness, Mandatory_QA_Flags for quality - Time periods: 2021-11-01 to 2021-11-30 vs 2021-12-10 to 2021-12-12 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const mayfield = ee.Geometry.Point([-88.6364, 36.7417]).buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around Mayfield const nov2021 = ['2021-11-01', '2021-11-30']; const dec10_12 = ['2021-12-10', '2021-12-12']; // 2. Data Acquisition function getBrightnessCollection(dateRange) { return ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') .filterDate(dateRange[0], dateRange[1]) .filterBounds(mayfield) .select('avg_rad'); } const novCollection = getBrightnessCollection(nov2021); const decCollection = getBrightnessCollection(dec10_12); const novSize = novCollection.size().getInfo(); const decSize = decCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`November 2021 Images: ${novSize}`); console.log(`December 10-12 Images: ${decSize}`); // Check for empty collections if (novSize === 0 || decSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean brightness function calculateMeanBrightness(collection) { const meanImg = collection.mean(); const stats = meanImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: mayfield, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); return stats.get('avg_rad').getInfo(); } const novBrightness = calculateMeanBrightness(novCollection); const decBrightness = calculateMeanBrightness(decCollection); // 4. Validation & Final Answer console.log(`November mean brightness: ${novBrightness}`); console.log(`December 10-12 mean brightness: ${decBrightness}`); // Check for calculation failures if (novBrightness === null || decBrightness === null || isNaN(novBrightness) || isNaN(decBrightness)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare brightness values if (novBrightness > decBrightness) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
